Auto follows the selected vehicle region. Manual channels also require system support. Mainland China prefers upper 5 GHz; other regions use conservative 2.4 GHz. Changes apply to the next connection.
USB connection help

1 · Keep the iPhone unlocked
Cancel this attempt, unplug the cable, unlock your iPhone and keep its screen on. Reconnect to the car USB data port. Allow USB access on the head unit and confirm any Trust or CarPlay prompt on the phone.

2 · Check the old CarPlay entry
If it still fails, open Settings → General → CarPlay on your iPhone. Use Forget This Car only for the old entry for this head unit, then reconnect while unlocked. You will need to pair again. Skip this step if no matching entry exists.

3 · Save the result
Change one condition at a time. After failure, open Logs and upload manually. Include the iPhone model, iOS version, whether it stayed unlocked, whether you removed the old entry, and whether you unplugged it yourself. The app cannot verify the phone lock or pairing state.
